notes.title: DEMO RELEASING TOMMOROW!!!
notes.notes:

[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613451/d1e6702467b51f47b5ba7e96987e39a56e09086b.gif"][/img]<This is quite exciting!!![/p][p]

[/p][p]I am VERY excited to hear what you all think, and I really want your feedback.

notes.title: Demo Releasing on the 11th! (maybe...)
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613451/6d4075f68e2a3b74ed0c27fa7e97530f875641b7.png"][/img]
[/p][p]Update:[/p][p]Steam's build review process took much longer than I thought it would... It will probably be released sometime this week. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]We are pleased to announce that the demo will be released on August 11, and I look forward to hearing your thoughts about it! The full game is majorly incomplete, and with this demo, we're hoping to get feedback about what we should change and what we should add. So make sure to download it on the 11th! (That is... if Steam verifies the game quick enough...)[/p][p][/p][p]Cya then! : )[/p][p][/p][p]-Gibson G.[/p]
